home.h1: This Is Not a Tour. This Is a Transformation.
home.h2: Wine & Flow is a curated sanctuary day in the heart of Málaga — crafted for those who seek presence, beauty, and the quiet luxury of being entirely here.

booking.trustLine: We read every message personally. You will hear from us within 24 hours.

fields.name: Full Name
fields.messagePlaceholder: Tell us anything else — what brings you here, what you're hoping for...

confirmation.heading: We've Received Your Enquiry
confirmation.body: Thank you for reaching out. Someone from the Wine & Flow team will be in touch within 24 hours to confirm your space and answer any questions.

booking.prebookingNote: Wine & Flow is a small, deeply intentional experience. We cap every session at ten guests — not as a marketing decision, but because anything larger would compromise the quality of what we offer.

contact.heading: Prefer a Direct Conversation?
contact.body: Some things are better said than typed. If you would like to speak with us before booking, we welcome a call or WhatsApp message.

questions.a: There is no formal dress code — only an invitation to dress for comfort and ease. We recommend layers you can move in freely for the yoga sessions, and something you feel graceful in for the dining experience.

Absolutely. Wine & Flow is designed from the ground up for the curious, not the expert. Our yoga sessions are entirely accessible and our sommelier makes the world of wine feel welcoming rather than intimidating.

questions.q: What if I have a dietary allergy or restriction?
questions.a: We ask all guests to share any allergies at the time of booking. Our chef designs around your needs. If you are unsure, please contact us directly before you arrive.
